source: BnF fr. 15906 (2), f. 521r cipher block aligned to its marginal decipherment and the interlinear gloss 'escripte'; values confirmed or extended on the f. 522v postscript
system: homophonic letter substitution, roughly one sign per letter, with word signs, numeral codes and null clusters (block frames FF ... Ƶ)
confidence_scale: high = 3+ consistent occurrences across both texts; medium = 2 or a clean single word; low = one occurrence or a look-alike may be lumped

m.confidence: medium; φ also reads n in a few places

ss.confidence: high (puisse, peussent, eussent, feussent, aussy, permission)

z.confidence: high (saisyz, ilz, veulz, choze, escripviez, mandiez, paiz, principaulz)

ħ (small h).confidence: high (je vous envoye; que vous Villeroy; je le vous ay)

ꞩ.confidence: high (luy en escripviez; et luy mandiez; que luy que j'ay)

ȼ (phi with bar).value: i, as in ilz / il (possibly qu'il)

ʃꝟ.confidence: high (de la Rochepot, de la paix x2, de laquelle)

18.value: sieur after mon / le; elsewhere looks like a null

10.value: a person, the 'luy' Villeroy is to write to

12.value: unknown (z 12 = '(de)puis'? at the head of the postscript)

ꝏ (after ⊔ 'du').value: unknown, probably a person code (despesche du ...)
